text: Added the cross-platform Gale consumer probe in the working tree. Against the temporary sibling source bridge it passes on JVM and Scala.js and completes linalgJS/Test/fullLinkJS; the probe covers DMatBuilder, dense matvec, and symmetric spectral consumption from Scala 3.4.2. It remains uncommitted with the temporary build bridge so HEAD never advertises a clean-checkout dependency it cannot resolve.
